newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The government will start its meeting around 1.30 p.m. to discuss revising the 1997 budget.
* The functioning of the government coalition is being examined by the Coordonation and Control Bureau of its main party, the Peasant-Christian Democratic Party.
* The Romanian Red Cross has sent humanitarian aid for people affected by floods in the southwestern county of Caras Severin. The aid is worth 210 million lei.
